scope: global static feature-set baselines; no ordered NEXT/STOP or adaptive policy

preprocessing.continuous_strategy: median imputation followed by standard scaling

evaluation.brier: single-horizon IPCW; censoring distribution estimated on train only

base_only.definition: all base features and no laboratory candidates

full_features.definition: all base features and all six laboratory candidates

static_top_k.definition: fixed order ranked by singleton incremental validation C-index over base

random.definition: fixed-seed random permutations; each K uses the first K laboratories

importance_greedy.definition: fixed global forward order maximizing validation C-index at each step

artifact_migration.changes: Descriptive identifiers, paths and dependent checksums; numerical results unchanged.
